name: CFG++
tagline: Manifold-constrained classifier-free guidance: extrapolate noise for the Tweedie x0 estimate, then renoise with the unconditional prediction to stay on the noise manifold.

key_hyperparams.name: w (cfg_guidance)
key_hyperparams.role: guidance scale; CFG++ tolerates lower scales

diff_from_baseline: Chung et al., CFG++ (ICLR 2025, arXiv:2406.08070). Same Tweedie x0 from CFG-extrapolated noise, but the DDIM renoising term uses epsilon_uncond instead of the extrapolated noise — interprets CFG as manifold-constrained perturbation and reduces saturation/off-manifold drift.

name: Standard CFG
tagline: Classical classifier-free guidance: linear extrapolation of conditional and unconditional noise predictions, used for both the x0 estimate and the renoising term.

key_hyperparams.name: w (cfg_guidance)
key_hyperparams.role: guidance scale; standard CFG needs the higher value

key_hyperparams.name: renoise_with
key_hyperparams.role: extrapolated noise reused for DDIM step

diff_from_baseline: Ho & Salimans, Classifier-Free Guidance (NeurIPS 2021 workshop). The default sampler in Stable Diffusion: linear noise extrapolation between conditional and unconditional predictions, with the same extrapolated noise used to renoise z_{t-1}. Reference comparator for CFG++.

name: Zero-Init CFG++
tagline: CFG++ sampler that skips the first K denoising steps (keeps the latent at its noise initialization) before applying manifold-constrained guidance.
pseudocode:
1. Initialize $z_T \sim \mathcal{N}(0,I)$
2. For step $s=0,\dots,T-1$:
3.   if $s < K$: continue (skip update, leave $z_t$ unchanged)
4.   else: predict $\epsilon_\varnothing, \epsilon_c$
5.       $\hat\epsilon = \epsilon_\varnothing + w(\epsilon_c - \epsilon_\varnothing)$
6.       $\hat{x}_0 = (z_t - \sqrt{1-\bar\alpha_t}\hat\epsilon)/\sqrt{\bar\alpha_t}$
7.       $z_{t-1} = \sqrt{\bar\alpha_{t-1}}\hat{x}_0 + \sqrt{1-\bar\alpha_{t-1}}\epsilon_\varnothing$ (CFG++ renoise)
8. Decode $\hat{x}_0$ at the last step.

key_hyperparams.name: K
key_hyperparams.role: number of initial steps to skip

diff_from_baseline: Inspired by zero-initialization analyses for low-NFE samplers. Combines CFG++ (epsilon_uncond renoising) with skipping the first K=2 denoising steps so guidance only acts after the latent has reached an informative noise level — useful in the 10-step regime evaluated here.
